home.ctaSubtitle: Start for free — no credit card, no subscription.

faqs.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faqs.a: No. Just describe what you want in plain text. The AI handles all the code.
No. You download the HTML and publish it anywhere you like — or publish it to the Nexio community for free.
No. Your credits stay in your account until you use them. No expiry date.

faqs.q: Can I edit the site after it's generated?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask for any changes via the AI chat, or use the visual editor to adjust text and colors directly.

faqs.q: How many sites can I create?
faqs.a: Each creation or revision costs 5 credits. With the Starter pack (100 credits) you can create up to 20 sites.

faqs.q: Can I roll back to a previous version?
faqs.a: Yes. Version history is saved automatically and you can roll back to any previous version with one click.
